title: Honorably released from active duty at Oakland
description: Larry was released from active duty at the U.S. Army Personnel Center, Oakland, California, as a Specialist 4 (E-4), with an honorable characterization of service, at the normal end of his term (AR 635-200, SPN 201). He was transferred to the U.S. Army Reserve control group administered from St. Louis, with a reserve obligation running to October 1969. The form credits 2 years, 1 month, 2 days of active service — with a remark that he was retained 1 month and 2 days beyond his term 'for the convenience of the government' — including 1 year, 1 month, 18 days of foreign service. Decorations listed: the Armed Forces Expeditionary Medal (Vietnam) and the Marksman badge (rifle).
researchNotes: The AFEM (Vietnam) was the award for Vietnam service in this period before the Vietnam Service Medal (created July 1965) was widely issued, and is itself documentary evidence of the Vietnam tour. The foreign-service total, counted back from this date, puts the start of continuous overseas service near mid-October 1964 — see the arrival entry's research notes. Promotions recorded on the form: PFC (E-3) June 29, 1964; SP4 (E-4) May 15, 1965 — each now its own entry. 2026-09-14: the SP4 date corrected from May 13 (the 2026-08-10 photo reading) to May 15, the clear scan's reading of item 3b (research/records-request/dd214-findings.md, "Clear-scan corrections").
